topic: Separación jurídica entre registro de entrada y admisión de una iniciativa legislativa popular
institution_procedure: Iniciativa Legislativa Popular ante Parlamento Vasco

observed_legal_content.article_5_1: Registro General assigns unique registration number to a proposed initiative before Mesa admissibility decision
observed_legal_content.article_5_2: Mesa examines documents and decides on admission or inadmission
observed_legal_content.article_5_7: Registered proposed initiatives must be made public by existing mechanisms, subject to personal data protection
observed_legal_content.article_5_8: Mesa inadmission agreements must be published in the Basque Parliament official bulletin
observed_legal_content.article_5_10: Promoters can withdraw a registered initiative before parliamentary consideration, with register annotation

verified_with: Public official BOE HTML text, article 5, consulted as documentation only
